Use native Agent Teams, or a better-adopted alternative such as @nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams.","id":"gh:1366256154","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-team-rooms","slug":"PerryLink/dsh-team-rooms","topics":["ai-agent","ai-agents","collaboration","cordis","cross-session","deepseek-harness","developer-tools","dsh","dsh-plugin","message-bus","multi-agent","task-board","team-rooms"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"RETIRED 2026-10-05 — the official DeepSeek Harness now ships the Agent Teams subsystem (dsh-experime"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ntal-agent-team). Use native Agent Teams, or a better-adopted alternative such as @nanmicoder/dsh-ag"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"-team). Use native Agent Teams, or a better-adopted alternative such as @nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# 🏠 dsh-team-rooms
- **1024 store channel**: `npm i -g dsh1024` once, then `dsh1024 plugin --profile"},{"id":"p2s2","text":" web add dsh-team-rooms` (counts toward the deepseek1024.com install ranking)."},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Persistent, cross-session multi-agent team rooms for DeepSeek Harness — members, a message bus, a "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"shared task board, and a shared timeline that survive restarts.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"*Each member is an independent DSH session; the room is the shared durable object between them.*"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> 🪦 **RETIRED — compatibility updates stopped as of 2026-10-05.** Team coordination is now **impleme"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"nted by the official harness itself** `dsh-experimental-agent-team` (with `-tool-agent-team`) provid"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"es an implicit-root roster, a **durable peer mailbox** and a shared **task DAG** with compare-and-se"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"t updates, plus a Web projection. ⚠️ The shipped `dsh-base` bundle keeps it **disabled** — a profile"},{"id":"p5s5","text":" patch enables it and disables the legacy continuable-child control names. Well-adopted **community "},{"id":"p5s6","text":"alternatives** also exist — for example `@nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams` (~13k weekly downloads), thoug"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"h as of 2026-10-05 its declared peers **stop below the `0.2.1` line**, so the host's compatibility g"},{"id":"p5s8","text":"uard **skips** it on `0.2.1-alpha.1` unless you add a per-version exemption. The one thing this pack"},{"id":"p5s9","text":"age did that the native subsystem does not is coordinate **independent sessions in separate processe"},{"id":"p5s10","text":"s**; with 589 weekly downloads against a native subsystem plus several community alternatives, that "},{"id":"p5s11","text":"niche no longer justifies compatibility upkeep. 👉 **Use the native Agent Teams, or a more widely ado"},{"id":"p5s12","text":"pted community alternative.** This repository stays public for reference."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"English · 简体中文 · Español · Português · हिन्दी"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Host `0.1.2-alpha.2` and later fails closed on the session event vocabulary, so this plugin no longe"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"r writes its log-only fact events (`team-room/fact`) there: facts route to the logger/panel channel "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"instead and the `teamRoom` projection degrades to an empty fold. Older rc lines (through `0.1.1-rc.2"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"`) keep the ignorable-marker discipline. The client half rides the current client packages (`dsh-api"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"-session-controller`, `dsh-client-ui-slots`, `dsh-client-ui-settings`, `dsh-client-locale`, `dsh-cli"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"ontroller`, `dsh-client-ui-slots`, `dsh-client-ui-settings`, `dsh-client-locale`, `dsh-client-web`)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**Data compatibility with `dsh-background-agents` 0.9.6 is a hard rule.** These strings are byte-ide"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ntical to 0.9.6 and must never be renamed: the storage domain `team_rooms`, the `teamRoom` projectio"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"n key, the `team-room/fact` session event type, and the `team-rooms` settings-slot id. An existing p"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"rofile therefore keeps its rooms, its member logs, and its settings page when you swap the plugin."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Surface | Status |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (verified 2026-09-25; dev and runtime pins `0.1.7-"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"rc.2`, peers `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.1.5-alpha.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.1.6-0 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.1.7-0 <"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"0.2.0`) |
| Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (host tools; the settings page needs"},{"id":"p12s4","text":" the Web client half and the storage-domain capability) |
| Model | Any (rooms carry no model route "},{"id":"p12s5","text":"— members are ordinary sessions) |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"`dsh-team-rooms` turns several independent sessions into one coordinated team:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"1. **The `/room` command family** — `create`, `join`, `leave`, `list`, `send`, `tasks`, `task add|as"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"sign|claim|done|delete`. Rooms are named, owned, and addressed by a stable room id you can paste int"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"o another session.
2. **Eight `room_*` tools** — `room_list_rooms`, `room_post`, `room_read`, `room_"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"list_tasks`, `room_create_task`, `room_claim_task`, `room_transfer_task`, `room_complete_task`. The "},{"id":"p15s5","text":"model works the shared board and the bus from inside its own session; `room_transfer_task` asks for "},{"id":"p15s6","text":"approval before a cross-member handoff.
3. **A durable room store** — members, the message bus (dire"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"cted or broadcast), the task board, and the timeline live in the `team_rooms` storage domain (SQLite"},{"id":"p15s8","text":" or JSONL backend — the deployment chooses; the plugin adds no service of its own) and recover acros"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"s DSH restarts.
4. **A Web settings page** — the Team Rooms settings section shows member status, th"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"e task board, and the timeline of every room the current session belongs to, read from the `teamRoom"},{"id":"p15s11","text":"` session projection and written back through the host `/room` command."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## How it works — and why it survives restarts"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The room store is the cross-session authority; the session projection is each member's own reconstru"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"cted copy. Two writes run at once and stay consistent:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Security boundaries"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- **Approval-gated handoffs.** `room_transfer_task` routes through the official approval seam and fa"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ils closed when no approval service is composed or no answerer grants it — nothing changes on a refu"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"sal.
- **Model-visible ⟺ logged.** Every delivered room message is a durable `user/message` in the m"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ember's own log; the shared timeline mirrors as log-only `team-room/fact` events. A room message can"},{"id":"p20s5","text":" never reach a model without being recorded.
- **Membership is the authorization boundary.** Every `"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"room_*` tool authorizes against the calling session's own membership; a non-member gets a stable rej"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"ection, not a partial write.
- **Retention is bounded.** Bus, timeline, and done-task windows are en"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"forced on every write, so a long-lived room cannot grow without limit.
- **No scheduling, no cross-m"},{"id":"p20s9","text":"achine members.** A member is a process-local session of this deployment."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- Rooms require the storage domain to be composed; without `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain`, the `/"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"room` command and the `room_*` tools are disabled.
- A room needs at least two members to be interes"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ting, and the roster is bounded by `maxMembersPerRoom`; membership is per session, not per user.
- T"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"here is no cross-machine membership: every member is a process-local session of this deployment.
- `"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"room_transfer_task` needs an approval answerer. Without one it fails closed by design, so automated "},{"id":"p22s6","text":"profiles that want handoffs must compose an approval service.
- Cost/usage accounting is out of scop"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"e here (that lived in the background-agent half); the room surfaces report structure, not spend."}],"truncated":true}
